Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 548 PM EST Sat Nov 21 2026
 

- Near record warmth will continue into Sunday with temperatures in 
the low to mid 60s.  

- Light rain showers likely late Sunday afternoon and evening. 

- Turning much colder Monday with below normal temperatures 
continuing through next week.

- Potential for light snow showers Monday night, mainly north of 
I-69.

&&

.AVIATION...

A region of deep layer dry air will persist across Se Mi into Sun 
morning within the southerly return flow associated with the large 
high pressure system across the northeastern US. This pattern will 
result in a persistence of clear skies and light winds through 
daybreak Sun morning. An approaching cold front will strengthen the 
southerly gradient on Sunday, allowing an uptick in wind speeds. 
Prefrontal moisture advection will also result in an increase in 
cloud cover through the day. Model probabilities indicate the better 
chances for MVFR based ceilings holding off until after 21Z Sun. 

For DTW...Although the sfc winds are forecast to turn a little more 
toward the south tonight, ongoing light southeast winds off Lake 
Erie has sustained slightly higher boundary layer moisture at DTW as 
evident by a little elevated sfc dewpoints. This will warrant a 
chance for some MVFR type visibilities in shallow fog toward 
daybreak Sun. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* None
